title: Paid Order Count by Region
description: Synthetic demo; paid_at in Asia/Shanghai, [2026-08-01, 2026-09-01). Actual outcome is determined by runtime validation.
question: Paid Order Count by Region

runtime_request.candidate_sql: SELECT o.region, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS paid_order_count FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed') AND o.paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' GROUP BY o.region
